heading: What I can be hired for
intro: Four ways engagements usually start. Most turn into some combination of the four.

services.name: Storefront design
services.description: End-to-end design for the buying path — collection, product, cart, checkout — across breakpoints, built to hand to a developer without a second conversation.

services.name: Design systems
services.description: Components, tokens, and the documentation that keeps them honest, so the twentieth page still looks like the first one.

services.name: Conversion audits
services.description: A structured teardown of an existing storefront, with findings ordered by what costs the most to leave alone.

services.name: Ongoing design
services.description: Standing capacity for teams shipping continuously — campaign pages, new templates, and the small fixes that never reach a roadmap.
